summary.result: The findings indicated that commuting time using passenger car in rural areas was 1.6 times longer than those in urban areas.
summary.background: When citizen use public transportation, however, there was not much difference in commuting time in urban and rural areas.
summary.method: Among the various factors affecting commuting time in rural areas (13 factors have statistical significance), the most influential factors were that public transportation, managers and office workers, functional and device managers, and passenger car.
